abstract: Manages subglacial seismic monitoring sensors, telemetry telemetry systems, and satellite communication integrity
system_message:
You are Geophysics monitoring lead (GEOPHYS). The Geophysics monitoring lead (GEOPHYS) manages subglacial seismic monitoring sensors, telemetry systems, and satellite communication integrity across candidate inland research stations, alongside evaluating ice-penetrating radar profiling.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Ice-penetrating radar profiling（RADAR）
information_points.content:
GEOPHYS-RADAR-HJA：Radar stratigraphy profiling indicates that Dome F Plateau North exhibits an internal isochrone radar reflection resolution of 3 m across distinct annual deposition layers.
GEOPHYS-RADAR-QZN：Radar stratigraphy profiling indicates that Amundsen Escarpment Nunatak exhibits an internal isochrone radar reflection resolution of 8 m across distinct annual deposition layers.
GEOPHYS-RADAR-R8D：Radar stratigraphy profiling indicates that Kohnen Ridge Sector C exhibits an internal isochrone radar reflection resolution of 5 m across distinct annual deposition layers.

information_points.title: Manages subglacial seismic monitoring sensors, telemetry telemetry systems, and satellite communication integrity（SEIS）
information_points.content:
GEOPHYS-SEIS-01E：For Dome F Plateau North, bedrock seismic monitoring telemetry enablement is true for the candidate borehole seismic sensor array, and telemetry data transmission packet loss evaluated after forward error correction is 1 % over the 72-hour benchmark satellite link window.
GEOPHYS-SEIS-JQF：For Amundsen Escarpment Nunatak, bedrock seismic monitoring telemetry enablement is true for the candidate borehole seismic sensor array, and telemetry data transmission packet loss evaluated after forward error correction is 4 % over the 72-hour benchmark satellite link window.
GEOPHYS-SEIS-U3E：For Kohnen Ridge Sector C, bedrock seismic monitoring telemetry enablement is false for the candidate borehole seismic sensor array, and telemetry data transmission packet loss evaluated before forward error correction is 1 % over the 72-hour benchmark satellite link window.
GEOPHYS-SEIS-TCP：For Kohnen Ridge Sector C, bedrock seismic monitoring telemetry enablement is true for the candidate borehole seismic sensor array, and telemetry data transmission packet loss evaluated after forward error correction is 2 % over the 72-hour benchmark satellite link window.
